summary: Pony AI Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a board meeting scheduled for May 26, 2026, to consider and approve unaudited financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, and to hold an earnings conference call. This is a routine reporting of a regular board meeting and earnings release, with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, typical for periodic financial updates. No deal terms or special situation disclosed.
